candidate_decisions.title: Qwen Code 0.28.6
candidate_decisions.reason: Managed-session parking, cold recovery and idempotent retry paths materially change the tracked tool.

candidate_decisions.title: FlashInfer NVFP4 attention
candidate_decisions.reason: Merged public code and Reactor deployment evidence make a Blackwell attention optimization testable.

candidate_decisions.title: Coding Agents Over-Edit
candidate_decisions.reason: A 7,660-trajectory study materially informs coding-agent review, with artifact limits preserved.

candidate_decisions.title: Attack Policy Selection in Monitor Evaluations
candidate_decisions.reason: The study shows monitor conclusions shift with attack generation, while no-code and proxy limits cap it at WATCH.

candidate_decisions.title: Nemotron 3.5 Parse open data and DFlash2
candidate_decisions.reason: Public datasets, weights, a recipe and speed model make document extraction directly testable.

candidate_decisions.title: llama.cpp AMD benchmark dashboard
candidate_decisions.reason: Public raw results and workflows establish a transparent AMD regression baseline.

candidate_decisions.title: Swarms, Flocks and Gangs
candidate_decisions.reason: A runnable TRL recipe supports a bounded one-day trial, while toy-task evidence prevents stronger claims.

candidate_decisions.title: Codex 0.174 alpha builds
candidate_decisions.reason: Only alpha builds shipped; no stable release was available.

candidate_decisions.title: Seventeen AI2 scientists on evaluating AI
candidate_decisions.reason: The interview synthesis proposes participatory evaluation but does not release an implemented benchmark.

candidate_decisions.title: GitHub Copilot code-review billing default
candidate_decisions.reason: The changelog exposes a date without time, so strict placement after the previous checkpoint is unresolved.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI healthcare model configurations
candidate_decisions.reason: The changelog remains date-only and cannot be placed inside the strict hourly window.

candidate_decisions.title: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 article
candidate_decisions.reason: The article describes the already indexed Mission Control 2.5 release and adds no recommendation-changing fact.

candidate_decisions.title: P-H3-Image 30-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: No controlled independent benchmark or licensing change was found; WATCH remains unchanged.

candidate_decisions.title: Other fixed-monitor changes
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable sources were unchanged or contained no verified recommendation-changing update.

candidate_decisions.title: Remaining current arXiv AI submissions
candidate_decisions.reason: The remaining papers lacked the combined artifacts, evidence and engineering value needed for this run.

candidate_decisions.title: Exceptional general-news check
candidate_decisions.reason: No verified general-news event met the exceptional broad-impact threshold.

candidate_decisions.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
candidate_decisions.reason: Reported internal newsroom guidance is not a new public Adobe policy, and the underlying New York Times memo was not independently accessible.

candidate_decisions.title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
candidate_decisions.reason: Public machine-checkable Lean sources materially shorten the GRH artifact, with absent mathematician review preserved.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
candidate_decisions.reason: The quoted 40% and 25% allowance corrections appear in a social post and user email report, but no public official statement with those figures was verified.

candidate_decisions.title: Porting Rockbox to an undocumented $9 Aliexpress 'YP3' MP3 Player with LLMs
candidate_decisions.reason: A detailed LLM-assisted hardware port is a case study rather than a reusable model, tool or engineering release.

candidate_decisions.title: Bare Metal Qwen
candidate_decisions.reason: High community heat merits an explicit IGNORE judgment: public assembly code is educational but lacks production adoption value.

candidate_decisions.title: KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini
candidate_decisions.reason: Final Apache-2.0 Korean-agent weights and deployment formats are useful; the pre-overlap timestamp is preserved as late discovery.

candidate_decisions.title: llamaindex/OCRia-1
candidate_decisions.reason: The model release predates the overlap; the in-window card change only links packaging formats and does not create a new event.

gap_review.scope: The weekly targeted gap review was not due; current active discovery and the due P-H3-Image review were completed.
